query:
select head.seq as "head_seq?",
                  head.head_hash as "head_hash?",
                  coalesce(log.max_seq, 0) as "max_seq!"
             from (
                    select max(seq) as max_seq
                      from audit_log
                     where tenant_id = $1
                  ) log
             left join audit_chain_heads head on head.tenant_id = $1
